free_text: Although the patient has a prior positive biopsy with an ISUP grade group 2 diagnosis, the rising PSA trajectory (from 4.2 ng/mL to 5.3 ng/mL) and the PI-RADS 4 finding warrant further investigation to characterize the known disease progression. The evidence retrieved shows a clear upward trend in PSA velocity (1.37 ng/mL/yr), which suggests the need for re-sampling to guide future management decisions. The conference resolved the conflict between the prior diagnosis and the rising metrics by leaning toward sampling to characterize the known disease.
